claims.quote: Hoplisoma copei, long known as Corydoras copei, is an armoured catfish from Peru, apparently endemic to the Río Pastaza basin and possibly the lower Río Marañón.

Type locality is 'Downstream of Río Huytoyacu, right tributary of Río Pastaza, about 40 kilometers north of Lago Rimachi, 4°13'S, 76°38'W, Peru', and this species appears to be endemic to the Pastaza basin and possibly the lower rio Marañón with a couple of records from the rio Samiria, a right bank tributary.
